recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-37952 unless a later FM decision changes the allowed Contract.author reference targets.
issue_request: FHIR-37952 was an Applied/Persuasive FM change request for R6 asking that Contract.author allow RelatedPerson, with resolution text saying to add RelatedPerson to the list of .author resources and allow profiles to remove it where not applicable.
initial_application: Git commit 18dadd6523f48f27e61b991819c4e862c399879f, titled "FHIR-37952 - Add RelatedPerson to Contract.author", added RelatedPerson to source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml. The current combined branch contains that targetProfile on Contract.author.
additional_context: Contract is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml is in current build scope. Jira search also found FHIR-22667, an older Published List.source issue that mentioned Contract.author as an author-like property needing committee review, but it concerned a different resource and did not itself decide Contract.author. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-37952 plus Contract.author/RelatedPerson found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/contract/structuredefinition-Contract.xml already lists http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/RelatedPerson as an allowed Contract.author targetProfile on the combined branch.

related_jiras.note: Older Published List.source RelatedPerson issue that mentioned Contract.author as another author-like property to ask the relevant committee about; it was not decided here because it concerns a different resource and was not necessary to reconcile FHIR-37952.
